 DAHUA LM22-A200Y – 21.5-inch FHD 100Hz LCD Monitor

 Elevate your visual experience with the DAHUA LM22-A200Y monitor—a blend of advanced performance and modern design. This 21.5-inch Full HD display is engineered to meet the diverse needs of professionals, gamers, and multimedia enthusiasts, delivering vibrant visuals and seamless motion for any task.

 EXQUISITE DESIGN & BUILD QUALITY

 The DAHUA LM22-A200Y boasts a sleek and contemporary design that complements any workspace. With its 21.5-inch screen, this monitor features ultra-thin bezels that not only enhance its aesthetic appeal but also maximize your viewing area. The sturdy construction and well-engineered stand provide exceptional stability, ensuring that the monitor remains secure during your busiest work sessions or intense gaming marathons. Its minimalist style seamlessly integrates into modern office setups, creative studios, or home entertainment systems.

 UNMATCHED VISUAL PERFORMANCE

 Experience stunning clarity and detail with a Full HD resolution of 1920 x 1080 pixels. Every image, video, or graphic is rendered with precision, allowing you to appreciate every nuance of your content. The 100Hz refresh rate guarantees ultra-smooth transitions and fluid motion, making fast-paced gaming and action-packed video playback a truly immersive experience. The crisp visuals and refined color reproduction bring life to your digital workspace, ensuring that text, graphics, and videos are displayed in their full brilliance.

 ADVANCED EYE CARE TECHNOLOGY

 Designed with long-duration use in mind, the DAHUA LM22-A200Y incorporates advanced eye protection features to minimize fatigue. Equipped with flicker-free technology and low blue light emission, this monitor reduces eye strain during extended periods of use. Whether you are editing detailed projects, browsing the web, or engaging in gaming sessions, these features help ensure visual comfort without compromising performance. By reducing the harmful effects of prolonged screen time, this monitor supports a healthier visual experience day after day.

 VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS

 Connectivity is a breeze with the DAHUA LM22-A200Y. The monitor is outfitted with both HDMI and VGA ports, offering seamless compatibility with a wide array of devices—from the latest laptops and gaming consoles to traditional desktop computers. This variety of connection options simplifies the setup process and enables you to switch between multiple multimedia sources effortlessly. Enjoy a hassle-free experience as you integrate this monitor into your existing digital ecosystem without the need for additional converters or adapters.

 IDEAL FOR EVERYDAY USE AND MULTIPLE APPLICATIONS

 Whether you’re a professional looking for precise color reproduction and sharp images for detailed design work, a gamer seeking responsive performance and fluid visuals, or a multimedia enthusiast who values vibrant and lifelike displays, the DAHUA LM22-A200Y is built to exceed expectations. Its versatile nature makes it the perfect solution for a range of applications:

 
• Office Productivity: Enjoy enhanced clarity for spreadsheets, documents, and creative software.

• Gaming: Benefit from the swift 100Hz refresh rate that minimizes motion blur and provides an edge in competitive play.

• Entertainment: Watch movies and videos in stunning Full HD with vibrant colors and crisp details.

 
 WHAT’S INCLUDED IN THE BOX

 To ensure a seamless setup, the DAHUA LM22-A200Y package includes everything you need:

 
• Monitor: The 21.5-inch Full HD display

• HDMI Cable: For high-definition video transmission

Whether you’re working, gaming, or enjoying multimedia content, this monitor provides sharp and vivid images with its VA panel technology. With an impressive 100Hz refresh rate , every frame is smooth, reducing eye strain while ensuring fluid visuals, especially for motion-intensive tasks.

 Outstanding Visual Performance with Full HD Resolution

 This monitor boasts a 1920 x 1080 (FHD) resolution , offering detailed and crisp image quality, perfect for both productivity and entertainment. The 4000:1 contrast ratio brings out deep blacks and bright whites, making every scene more vibrant and dynamic. Whether you’re editing photos, watching movies, or browsing the web, this monitor’s clarity won’t disappoint.

 Fluid Motion with a 100Hz Refresh Rate

 Say goodbye to choppy visuals. The MSI PRO MP245V supports a 100Hz refresh rate , which means smoother action scenes and faster transitions. This is especially crucial for gamers and video editors who need seamless visuals without lag or ghosting. Coupled with a 1ms (MPRT) response time , this monitor guarantees minimal motion blur, enhancing your overall viewing experience.

 Versatile Connectivity with HDMI and VGA Ports

Its matte black finish gives it a sophisticated look, complementing modern workspaces and gaming stations alike. Plus, the Kensington lock feature adds an extra layer of security, ensuring that your monitor stays safe in public or shared environments.

 Eco-Friendly and Ergonomic Features

ASUS VA24EHF: A Perfect Blend of Performance and Comfort 

 The ASUS VA24EHF is a 24-inch Full HD gaming monitor that combines high-quality visuals with excellent eye care features. With a 100Hz refresh rate and a 1ms response time, this monitor is built for smooth and responsive gaming. The VA24EHF also features ASUS' Eye Care technology, reducing blue light and flicker for a more comfortable viewing experience. Whether you're playing games or working on your next project, this monitor provides sharp, vibrant visuals with reduced strain for extended use.

 
 

 Key Features

 24" Full HD (1920x1080) Resolution 

 
• The Full HD resolution offers crisp, clear visuals, perfect for gaming, movies, and everyday tasks.

• Enjoy vibrant colors and sharp details with the 24-inch screen size, providing the ideal balance between screen real estate and desk space.

 
 100Hz Refresh Rate 

 
• With a 100Hz refresh rate, the VA24EHF delivers smooth, fluid visuals during fast-paced action, reducing motion blur for a more immersive experience.

• Ideal for gaming genres like FPS, racing, and action games that require fast movements.

 
 1ms Response Time 

 
• The quick 1ms response time minimizes ghosting and blurring, ensuring sharp and clear visuals, even during high-speed gaming moments.

• Achieve superior control and precision in competitive gaming.

 
 ASUS Eye Care Technology 

 
• ASUS Flicker-Free technology reduces flickering to help minimize eye strain during extended gaming sessions.

• Blue light reduction technology lowers harmful blue light exposure, keeping your eyes protected and reducing fatigue.

 
 Wide Viewing Angles 

 
• The VA24EHF offers wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles, ensuring consistent color and contrast from any position, whether you're sitting directly in front or off to the side.

 
 Sleek and Stylish Design 

 
• The monitor features a slim profile with ultra-narrow bezels, perfect for multi-monitor setups.

• The sleek black design complements any gaming setup, providing a modern and professional look.

 
 Ergonomic Stand 

 
• The ergonomic stand allows for tilt adjustments, letting you find the perfect viewing angle for comfort during extended use.

• Ensure a comfortable gaming or working experience, no matter how long you’re at the screen.

 
 VESA Mount Compatibility 

 
• The VA24EHF is compatible with VESA mounts (75mm x 75mm), giving you the flexibility to mount the monitor to a wall or monitor arm for a more streamlined setup.

 
 Multiple Connectivity Options 

 
• Equipped with HDMI and VGA ports, the VA24EHF ensures easy connectivity to a wide range of devices, including gaming consoles, PCs, and laptops.

Samsung Essential Monitor S3 S32GF 24″ FHD 120Hz IPS Monitor

 The Samsung S3 24 S32GF is a modern everyday monitor designed for users who want smooth performance, clear Full HD image quality and a clean slim design for work, study, entertainment and casual gaming. The Middle East model LS24F320GAMXUE features a 24-inch flat IPS panel , 1920 × 1080 Full HD resolution , maximum 120Hz refresh rate , and 5ms GTG response time .

 Samsung combines these specifications with useful everyday features including Eye Saver Mode, Flicker Free technology, Game Picture Mode and Auto Source Switch , giving the S3 more flexibility than a basic office display while keeping the design simple and practical.

 24-Inch Full HD Display

 1920 × 1080 Resolution

 The Samsung LS24F320 uses a native Full HD resolution of 1920 × 1080 pixels with a standard 16:9 aspect ratio . This resolution remains an excellent choice for a 24-inch monitor because it provides clear text, detailed images and broad compatibility with desktop computers, laptops and other HDMI devices.

 Its active display area measures approximately 527.04 × 296.46mm , providing enough desktop space for office applications, web browsing, video playback, studying and everyday multitasking.

 IPS Panel Technology

 Clear Colours from Wide Viewing Angles

 The Samsung S3 24 uses an IPS panel , which helps maintain colour consistency and image clarity even when the display is viewed from different positions.

 Samsung specifies wide 178° horizontal and 178° vertical viewing angles , allowing the picture to remain clear without requiring the user to sit directly in front of the screen.

 The panel provides typical brightness of 250 cd/m² , a typical static contrast ratio of 1000:1 , support for up to 16.7 million colours , and approximately 72% NTSC 1976 colour gamut coverage .

 These specifications make the monitor suitable for everyday productivity, multimedia, browsing, studying and general home or office use.

 120Hz Refresh Rate

 Smoother Everyday Performance

 One of the biggest upgrades of this 120Hz IPS Monitor compared with traditional 60Hz or 75Hz office displays is its maximum 120Hz refresh rate .

 Samsung explains that the higher refresh rate helps reduce visible lag and motion blur when playing games, watching videos or working with moving content. The default refresh rate may initially be set to 60Hz and can be adjusted up to 120Hz when supported by the connected source.

 A 120Hz refresh rate also makes normal desktop use feel noticeably smoother, including scrolling through websites, moving windows and navigating applications.

 5ms GTG Response Time

 Responsive Image Performance

 Samsung officially specifies a 5ms GTG response time for the S32GF.

 GTG, or Gray-to-Gray, represents the time required for pixels to transition between different shades. Combined with the 120Hz refresh rate, the 5ms response specification is suitable for daily computing, multimedia and casual gaming.

 The S3 is not positioned as a dedicated high-end esports monitor like Samsung’s Odyssey series, but its 120Hz panel provides a significant improvement in smoothness compared with conventional productivity monitors.

 Game Picture Mode

 Optimized Image Settings for Games

 Samsung includes Game Picture Mode , allowing users to adjust colour and image contrast for different game scenarios.

 Samsung describes the feature as helping improve visibility in dark scenes and optimizing the displayed game image so important details are easier to see.

 This adds useful gaming functionality for users who want one monitor for both everyday work and casual gaming.

 It is important to list the specifications correctly: Samsung officially states that this model does not support AMD FreeSync or NVIDIA G-Sync.

 Eye Saver Mode

 More Comfortable Long Sessions

 The Samsung Essential Monitor S3 includes Eye Saver Mode , designed to reduce blue-light exposure during extended viewing sessions.

Fast Response, Smooth Gameplay, and Vivid Colors for Competitive Gaming 

 The LG 24G411A-B UltraGear™ gaming monitor is built for gamers seeking responsive performance and immersive visuals. Featuring a 24-inch Full HD IPS display , 144Hz overclocked refresh rate , and 1ms Motion Blur Reduction , this monitor delivers smooth gameplay with vibrant colors and reduced screen tearing for an enhanced gaming experience. 

 
 Key Features

 1. 24-Inch Full HD IPS Display 

 
• Enjoy crisp visuals and accurate color reproduction with a 1920 × 1080 Full HD IPS panel , offering wide viewing angles and vivid image quality. 

 
 2. 144Hz Overclock Refresh Rate 

 
• Experience ultra-smooth gameplay with a native 120Hz refresh rate , overclockable up to 144Hz for improved responsiveness during fast-paced gaming. 

 
 3. 1ms Motion Blur Reduction (MBR) 

 
• Minimize motion blur and improve clarity in competitive games where every millisecond matters. 

 
 4. NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible & AMD FreeSync™ 

 
• Reduce screen tearing and stuttering with adaptive sync technology for smoother, low-latency gaming experiences. 

 
 5. HDR10 & 99% sRGB Color Coverage 

 
• Enjoy richer visuals, deeper contrast, and accurate colors with HDR10 support and 99% sRGB coverage . 

 
 6. Gaming Enhancement Features 

 
• Includes Black Stabilizer , Crosshair , Dynamic Action Sync , and FPS Counter for a competitive advantage. 

 
 7. Slim Bezel Design 

 
• Modern, minimal bezels provide a cleaner setup and a more immersive viewing experience.

 More about Dell E2423H 24 Monitor 

 

 The essentials you need to be more productive

 
 Wide viewing angle: See your work in superb FHD clarity and get consistent views across a wide 178°/178° viewing angle.

 Crisp images: Get an impressive 3000:1 contrast ratio for deeper blacks, brighter whites and vivid colour.

 Easy on the eyes: This monitor has a flicker-free screen with ComfortView, a software feature that reduces harmful blue light emissions.

 It’s designed to optimise eye comfort even over an extended period of time.

 

 Functional, space – saving design

 
 Convenient connectivity: Connect to current and legacy systems via VGA and DP ports.

 Maximize your desktop: Cut clutter with space – saving features like a compact stand and improved cable management

 that hides cables while complementing any workspace.

 Clean, simple design: A slim bezel adds a modern look.

 Adapts to your needs: Make your workspace your own with VESA – compatible mounts and stands.

 

 

 
 Dell Display Manager

 
 Productive at every level: Easy Arrange allows you to easily tile multiple applications across one or more screens with 38 pre-set

 

 window partitions and the ability to personalize up to five windows, giving you improved multitasking abilities.

 Seamless transitions: The auto – restore feature remembers where you left off, so applications will go back to where you left them, even after you’ve unplugged.

 The key to convenience: Shortcut keys can save you even more time, letting you easily configure your display management settings so you can get to work faster.

 More ways to manage: Asset management reports allow IT managers to quickly capture and track monitor information as well as configure multiple monitors at once through a single setup.

 

 

 
 Green thinking for today and tomorrow

 
 
• Environmental standards: This monitor uses 85% PCR (Post-consumer Recyclable) plastic in the design and meets the latest environmental standards such as EnergyStar ® 

 
 

 and TCO Certified Edge, and is registered EPEAT ® Gold.

 
• Eco-conscious packaging: Designed with the environment in mind, Dell commercial monitors come in 100% recyclable cardboard packaging.

• Energy conservation: Save energy with Power Nap, a feature that dims or puts your monitor to sleep when it’s not in use.

• Advancing sustainability: Dell Technologies is committed to reducing environmental impact throughout the product lifecycle.

MSI G244F 24-Inch FHD IPS Gaming Monitor – 170Hz 1ms FreeSync Premium Flat Display

 MSI G244F Gaming Monitor for Smooth Competitive Gameplay

 The MSI G244F Gaming Monitor is designed for gamers who want fast performance, clear visuals, and reliable everyday use in one clean display. With a 24-inch Full HD screen, IPS panel, 170Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, and AMD FreeSync Premium support, this monitor delivers a smooth and responsive experience for gaming, work, streaming, and daily computer use.

 This monitor is a strong choice for PC gamers who need speed and image clarity without taking too much desk space. Its flat black design gives it a modern look that fits easily into gaming setups, office desks, home workstations, and content setups.

 Fast 170Hz Refresh Rate

 Smoother Motion for Fast Games

 The MSI G244F Gaming Monitor features a fast 170Hz refresh rate , giving users smoother motion compared to standard monitors. A higher refresh rate helps the display show more frames per second, making gameplay feel more fluid and responsive.

 This is especially useful in fast-paced games such as FPS, racing, sports, battle royale, and action titles. When movement is quick, a 170Hz display can help make aiming, tracking, and reaction feel more natural.

 Better Gaming Response

 For competitive gamers, smooth motion can make a noticeable difference. The MSI G244F helps reduce visual delay and gives players a better sense of control during intense gameplay. Whether you are moving quickly across the map, aiming at targets, or reacting to sudden action, the fast refresh rate helps keep the experience clear and responsive.

 1ms Response Time

 Reduced Blur and Ghosting

 The 1ms response time helps reduce motion blur and ghosting, giving you clearer visuals during fast movement. This is important for games where every second matters and screen clarity can affect your performance.

 With faster pixel response, moving objects appear sharper, allowing you to enjoy cleaner gameplay in fast scenes. This makes the MSI G244F a great option for gamers who play competitive titles and want a display that can keep up with quick action.

 Clearer Visuals During Movement

 During fast turns, quick camera movement, or high-speed racing scenes, slower monitors may show blur or trailing effects. The MSI G244F is built to deliver a cleaner visual experience, helping users stay focused on the game without distracting motion effects.

 24-Inch Full HD Display

 Sharp and Clear Resolution

 The MSI G244F comes with a 24-inch Full HD display , offering sharp and clear visuals for gaming, browsing, office work, and entertainment. Full HD resolution is a practical choice for gamers who want smooth performance and good image quality.

 The 24-inch size is also ideal for many gaming setups because it gives a comfortable viewing area without taking too much space. It works well on small desks, gaming stations, and dual-monitor setups.

 Practical Size for Gaming Setups

 A 24-inch screen is popular among competitive gamers because it allows users to see the full display comfortably without moving their head too much. This helps keep important game details in view and makes the monitor suitable for focused gameplay.

 IPS Panel Technology

 Vivid Colors and Wide Viewing Angles

 The IPS panel delivers clear colors and wide viewing angles, making the screen look good from different positions. This is useful for gaming, watching videos, working, and sharing the screen with others.

 IPS technology helps produce more consistent colors compared to basic display panels, giving the MSI G244F better image quality for both gaming and everyday use.

 Great for Gaming and Entertainment

ASUS TUF Gaming VG259Q5A – 200Hz Fast IPS 0.3ms Gaming Monitor 

 

 

 

 The ASUS TUF Gaming VG259Q5A is engineered for gamers who demand the ultimate balance between speed, clarity, and reliability. It brings together ASUS’s proven durability with cutting-edge visual performance, offering an immersive gaming experience that delivers precision, smoothness, and style in every frame. Designed for both competitive and casual gamers, this monitor embodies the spirit of the TUF lineup — strong, stable, and built to last.

 Unleash the Power of 200Hz 

 At the heart of the VG259Q5A lies its 200Hz ultra-fast refresh rate , ensuring every motion on screen appears smooth and fluid. Whether you are engaged in fast-paced FPS battles, racing through high-speed tracks, or reacting to split-second situations in MOBAs, the 200Hz refresh rate guarantees that you see and respond faster than ever before. Each frame is drawn with exceptional consistency, reducing input lag and motion blur, helping you achieve that vital competitive edge.

 This display goes far beyond traditional 60Hz or even 144Hz monitors. With 200Hz, the responsiveness feels instantaneous — a difference that’s not only visible but truly tangible for anyone who values precision and speed in gameplay.

 Fast IPS Panel – True Colors, True Speed 

 The VG259Q5A utilizes Fast IPS panel technology , combining the wide viewing angles and vibrant color accuracy of traditional IPS with response times approaching those of TN panels. Thanks to ASUS’s proprietary technology, the pixel transition time can reach as low as 0.3ms (minimum) , drastically reducing ghosting and motion blur during fast movement scenes.

 Colors appear natural and consistent from every angle, making this monitor not only perfect for gaming but also suitable for media creation, streaming, and daily productivity. The factory-calibrated panel ensures realistic tones and smooth gradients, covering a rich color gamut that brings virtual worlds to life with true-to-source accuracy.

 ELMB Sync and Adaptive-Sync for Tear-Free Gameplay 

 ASUS integrates its ELMB Sync (Extreme Low Motion Blur Sync) technology, allowing motion blur reduction to work simultaneously with Adaptive-Sync or FreeSync Premium . This unique combination eliminates screen tearing and ghosting without sacrificing brightness or clarity. The result is incredibly sharp visuals even at high frame rates. When every millisecond counts, ELMB Sync ensures that fast-moving enemies, environmental effects, and animations appear crystal clear. You stay focused and in control.

 Built for Endurance – The TUF Gaming Philosophy

 The KOORUI GN03 27″ QHD 170Hz VA is a high-performance 1440p gaming monitor engineered to deliver ultra-sharp visual detail, deep contrast, and fluid frame rates for immersive gaming and content consumption. Featuring a spacious 27-inch Quad HD (2560×1440) resolution panel, this display provides 1.7 times the pixel density of standard Full HD monitors, bringing crisp textures, fine detail, and expanded screen real estate to your desktop setup.

 Equipped with a fast 170Hz refresh rate and a rapid 1ms (MPRT) response time, the GN03 minimizes motion blur, ghosting, and input lag during high-speed action scenes. Built on a high-contrast VA panel with HDR10 support, 3000:1 static contrast, and Adaptive-Sync dynamic frame synchronization, the KOORUI GN03 delivers vibrant color accuracy, deep blacks, and tear-free gameplay for competitive and AAA gaming enthusiasts alike.

 
 
 
 
 27″ QHD 1440P Resolution & High-Contrast VA Panel

 Crisp Visual Clarity with Deep Blacks and 3000:1 Dynamic Contrast Ratio

 Step up from standard 1080p rendering with 2560×1440 Quad HD resolution. The 27-inch panel offers significantly higher pixel density, rendering sharper game graphics, finer text details, and enhanced visual clarity across all your favorite titles.

 Utilizing advanced VA panel technology with a high 3000:1 static contrast ratio, the GN03 produces deep, ink-like blacks and bright whites. Combined with HDR10 support and 100% sRGB color gamut coverage, games and media display rich color depth and vivid highlights.

 
 170Hz Refresh Rate & 1ms MPRT Response Speed

 Ultra-Smooth Motion Tracking and Instant Response in Fast-Paced Games

 In competitive gaming, high frame rates yield faster reaction times. The KOORUI GN03 features an over-clocked 170Hz refresh rate, delivering up to 170 clean frames per second for fluid movement tracking.

 Paired with a fast 1ms Moving Picture Response Time (MPRT), pixel color transitions happen almost instantly, reducing motion blur, trailing, and smearing during rapid camera movements in first-person shooters and fast racing games.

Incredible Speed for Competitive Gaming

 The KOORUI G2711P is engineered to meet the demanding needs of competitive gamers. Featuring an impressive 200Hz refresh rate combined with an ultra-fast 1ms Motion Picture Response Time (MPRT) , this monitor delivers ultra-smooth motion clarity that virtually eliminates motion blur and ghosting. This means fast-paced games like first-person shooters, racing simulators, and real-time strategy titles display crisp and fluid visuals, allowing you to react faster and play more effectively. The high refresh rate also reduces input lag, providing an edge in competitive gaming environments where every millisecond counts. Whether you’re dodging enemy fire or racing down the track at breakneck speeds, the KOORUI G2711P ensures your gameplay looks and feels buttery smooth.

 Stunning Color Accuracy with Fast IPS Technology

 At the heart of the G2711P lies a Fast IPS panel , which combines the speed of traditional TN panels with the superior color accuracy and wide viewing angles of IPS technology. This means you get vibrant, consistent colors even when viewing the screen from extreme angles — up to 178 degrees horizontally and vertically. The monitor covers approximately 99% of the sRGB color gamut and around 89% of the DCI-P3 color space , delivering true-to-life colors and deeper saturation. This makes the G2711P not only ideal for gaming but also suitable for content creators, photo editors, and multimedia enthusiasts who need reliable color accuracy in their daily workflow.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400 Certified for Dynamic Visuals

 To elevate your gaming and media experience, the KOORUI G2711P supports VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification . This feature enhances the dynamic range of images, making dark scenes richer and brighter areas more vivid without sacrificing detail. HDR content becomes more immersive thanks to higher peak brightness and improved contrast ratio. Whether you’re exploring shadowy dungeons, watching HDR-enabled movies, or playing visually rich AAA titles, the enhanced contrast and brightness offered by HDR 400 give you a noticeable boost in image quality, revealing subtle details that standard monitors miss.

 Adaptive Sync Technology for Tear-Free Gameplay

 Nothing ruins an immersive game like screen tearing or stuttering. The G2711P addresses this with support for both AMD FreeSync Premium and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility . These adaptive sync technologies work by synchronizing the monitor’s refresh rate with the frame rate output of your graphics card. This synchronization eliminates the tearing artifacts and stutter caused by mismatched frame rates, ensuring a smoother and more visually coherent experience. Whether you’re running an AMD Radeon or NVIDIA GeForce GPU, you benefit from a buttery-smooth frame delivery that maintains high responsiveness.

 Immersive 27-Inch Full HD Display

 The 27-inch diagonal screen size strikes an excellent balance between immersion and desktop space. The Full HD resolution of 1920×1080 pixels provides sharp and detailed visuals, while the fast IPS panel ensures vibrant colors and wide viewing angles. The monitor features an ultra-thin bezel design on three sides, which minimizes distractions and makes it an excellent choice for multi-monitor setups. Whether you’re gaming, watching videos, or working, the large screen real estate combined with crisp resolution and minimal bezels enhances your overall viewing experience.

 Designed for Comfort and Versatility

 Ergonomics and comfort are priorities in the design of the KOORUI G2711P. The monitor stand supports tilt adjustment, allowing you to find the perfect viewing angle that reduces neck and eye strain during long gaming or work sessions. For users seeking more flexibility, the monitor also supports a VESA 75×75 mm mount , making it compatible with a wide range of monitor arms and wall mounts. This extra visual contrast helps you spot opponents concealed in dark corners or low-light map zones with ease.

Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F 27″ QHD 200Hz IPS Gaming Monitor

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 27 G53F is a high-speed QHD gaming monitor designed for players who want a strong combination of image detail, fast refresh rate and responsive gameplay. The exact regional model is LS27FG532EMXUE , featuring a 27-inch flat IPS panel , 2560 × 1440 QHD resolution , maximum 200Hz refresh rate , and 1ms MPRT response time .

 Compared with a standard Full HD gaming monitor, the QHD resolution provides around 1.7 times the pixel density of 1920 × 1080, giving games, text and desktop content noticeably sharper detail while maintaining a practical 27-inch screen size. Samsung positions the G53F as a gaming-focused Odyssey display, with features including AMD FreeSync Premium, Black Equalizer, Virtual Aim Point and Auto Source Switch.

 27-Inch QHD Gaming Display

 2560 × 1440 Resolution

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F uses a native QHD resolution of 2560 × 1440 with a traditional 16:9 aspect ratio .

 Samsung highlights QHD as one of the monitor’s main features because it provides considerably more image detail than Full HD while remaining easier to drive at high frame rates than 4K. This makes the resolution particularly attractive for gaming PCs equipped with modern mid-range and high-performance graphics cards.

 The active display area measures 596.736 × 335.664mm , giving the monitor a conventional 27-inch desktop footprint suitable for gaming, productivity and entertainment.

 IPS Panel with Wide Viewing Angles

 Consistent Colours Across the Screen

 The Samsung LS27FG532 uses an IPS panel , offering wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles .

 Samsung specifies typical brightness of 300 cd/m² , minimum brightness of 240 cd/m² and a typical static contrast ratio of 1000:1 . The display supports up to 16.7 million colours and Samsung lists NTSC 1976 colour gamut coverage of 72% or higher.

 IPS technology makes the monitor suitable for users who value consistent colour and image quality across different viewing positions while still wanting a high-refresh gaming display.

 200Hz Refresh Rate

 Smooth High-Speed Gaming

 One of the biggest advantages of this 200Hz Gaming Monitor is its maximum refresh rate of 200Hz .

 A higher refresh rate allows compatible hardware to display more frames per second than conventional 60Hz, 75Hz, 120Hz or 144Hz monitors. This can make motion appear smoother and controls feel more responsive when the gaming PC can produce sufficiently high frame rates.

 The 200Hz specification makes the Odyssey G5 particularly interesting for competitive titles such as shooters, racing games and esports titles where fast movement and rapid input response are important.

 1ms MPRT Response Time

 Fast Motion Clarity

 Samsung specifies a 1ms MPRT response time for the G53F.

 This feature is designed to improve motion clarity during fast gameplay and reduce visible blur in rapid scenes. Samsung notes that actual response behaviour can depend on monitor settings, content and testing conditions.

 Combined with the 200Hz refresh rate, the fast response specification gives the monitor a gaming-oriented performance profile rather than simply focusing on resolution and image quality.

 AMD FreeSync Premium

 Reduced Tearing and Stutter

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F supports AMD FreeSync Premium .

 This variable refresh rate technology allows the monitor and a compatible graphics processor to better synchronise their refresh behaviour. The goal is to reduce screen tearing, stuttering and interruptions when frame rates change during gameplay.

 For gamers using compatible AMD graphics hardware, FreeSync Premium provides an additional advantage when frame rates fluctuate instead of remaining fixed at the monitor’s maximum refresh rate.

 Improved Highlight and Shadow Detail

Compact and Reliable Performance with the Samsung 32" Odyssey G5 G55C QHD 165Hz Curved

 Dive into your games with the Samsung 32" Odyssey G5 G55C QHD 165Hz Curved monitor—a sleek, immersive display that blends sharp visuals with fluid performance. Featuring a 32-inch VA panel with QHD resolution (2560x1440), a 1000R curve that wraps around your field of view, and a 165Hz refresh rate paired with a 1ms MPRT response time, this monitor delivers smooth, blur-free action for every firefight or race. With AMD FreeSync support to eliminate tearing and HDR10 for vibrant contrast, it’s built to bring your gaming worlds to life. Finished in bold Black, the G55C combines ergonomic tilt adjustments, Eye Saver Mode, and a flicker-free design—perfect for long sessions, whether you’re a casual player or a competitive enthusiast chasing the next win.

 
 Key Features

 
• 
 QHD Resolution: Packing 1.7x the pixel density of Full HD, the 2560x1440 display offers pin-sharp details—see every texture and enemy with clarity across its 32-inch span.

• 
 1000R Curved Panel: Matches the natural curve of your eyes, filling your peripheral vision for a heart-pounding, immersive experience—puts you right in the character’s shoes.

• 
 165Hz Refresh Rate: Refreshes 165 times per second to keep gameplay ultra-smooth—lag-free action lets you react the moment you spot your target.

• 
 1ms MPRT Response Time: Lightning-fast pixel transitions minimize motion blur—jump on enemies with frames that stay crisp, even in high-speed chaos.

• 
 AMD FreeSync: Syncs the monitor’s refresh rate with your GPU, cutting screen tearing and stuttering—delivers seamless scenes for gaming or movies.

• 
 HDR10 Support: Boosts contrast with deep blacks and bright whites—unlocks vivid, lifelike visuals that make every shadow and highlight pop.

• 
 Eye Comfort Features: Eye Saver Mode cuts blue light, while flicker-free tech reduces strain—game longer with less fatigue, day or night.

 The KOORUI GA01 is a high-performance 31.5-inch curved gaming monitor engineered for serious gamers. With a stunning QHD resolution, ultra-fast refresh rate, and immersive 1500R curvature, it delivers breathtaking visuals and ultra-smooth gameplay.

•

Equipped with top-tier specs— Fast IPS panel , 200 Hz refresh rate , QHD (2560×1440) resolution, and 1 ms response time —this powerhouse display is designed to elevate every aspect of your gameplay.

 
 🎯 Immersive QHD Clarity on a 27″ Canvas

 The G2721P features a crisp 2560×1440 (QHD) resolution on a spacious 27‑inch Fast IPS panel, balancing vibrant detail and system efficiency. This pixel density sharpens textures, smoothens fonts, and enriches in-game visuals, bringing depth to richly designed worlds while remaining accessible to a wide range of PCs. Whether you’re exploring photorealistic environments, monitoring real-time feeds, or editing 1440p videos, QHD delivers outstanding clarity and immersion.

 Competitive gamers will appreciate the silky smooth motion of a 200 Hz refresh rate , significantly surpassing typical 144 Hz options. Every frame updates swiftly, reducing motion blur and input lag for seamless transitions. Paired with a 1 ms MPRT , the G2721P minimizes after-image effects, making fast-paced titles like first-person shooters and racing games fluid and precise.

 
 🔵 Fast IPS – Precision Color Meets Speed

 Fast IPS technology offers the hard-hitting speed of TN panels without MSI’s color distortion or viewing angle penalty. With a 90% DCI‑P3 wide color gamut and HDR400 support, expect vibrant reds, rich greens, and deep blues—perfect for richly textured open worlds and visually demanding titles. The 178° viewing angles ensure consistent picture quality, whether you’re gaming solo or sharing the screen.

 
 🌟 HDR400 for Enhanced Contrast and Vibrance

While not as intense as higher HDR tiers, it still brings visible detail to shadows and brighter zones, enhancing realism. Blacks appear deeper, whites more vivid, and midtones richer, resulting in gaming visuals that pop.

 The G2721P sports a modern minimalist design with thin bezels—ideal for multi-monitor setups. A clean matte finish and subtle KOORUI branding complete its sleek aesthetic. Functionally, it offers tilt adjustment and is VESA‑compatible (75×75 mm) for wall or arm mounting, giving gamers numerous ergonomic setup options.

Samsung Odyssey G5 27″ inch QHD 180Hz IPS 1ms Gaming Monitor LS27DG502E

 More about Samsung G5 QHD 27″ 

 Boost your reality

 QHD resolution & Fast IPS panel 

 Your gaming world, more lifelike than ever before. Packing in 1.7 times the pixel density of Full HD, QHD resolution boasts incredibly detailed, pin-sharp images. Fast IPS panel delivers clear colors and a wide 178º viewing angle for clarity from any viewpoint. With more pixels and greater depth, games are closer to reality than ever before.

 

 Hidden details shining bright

 VESA DisplayHDR 400 

 Reveal the whole picture. DisplayHDR 400 delivers more contrast, with deeper blacks and brighter whites to help you uncover enemies or secrets lurking in the shadows. Even in dark scenes, every detail shines with clarity.

 

 React in real time

 180Hz refresh rate & 1ms response time(GtG) 

 Speed through scenes. 180Hz refresh rate eliminates lag for exhilarating gameplay with ultra-smooth action. Jump on enemies right when you see them with a 1ms response time(GtG) for frames with minimal blur.

 * “1 ms” means one milliseconds which is the range of avg. response time between 1.00ms to 1.99ms truncated to whole number.* Based on GtG measured under internal test conditions. Results may vary by content and monitor settings (requires ‘Extreme mode’ setting).* GtG (Gray to Gray) measures the time taken for a monitor pixel to change from one gray value to another. 

 

 Stay in sync with the action

 AMD FreeSync 

 Superfluid entertainment experience. AMD Radeon FreeSync™ keeps your monitor and graphics card refresh rate in sync to reduce image tearing. Watch movies and play games without interruptions. Even fast scenes look seamless and smooth.

 * Image simulated for illustrative purposes. 

 

 Fresh eyes win more

 Eye Saver Mode & Less Screen Flickering 

 Play for even longer. Eye Saver Mode minimizes blue light to help keep your eyes relaxed and comfortable when gaming for extended periods. The Odyssey G5 also reduces irritating and tiring screen flicker, so you can focus longer with less distraction and eye strain.

Samsung Odyssey G5 (FG502E) (2026) 32″ Flat Monitor IPS 2K (2560 x 1440) 180Hz 1ms(GTG), HDR10, 99% sRGB, 8 Bit, G-Sync Compatible w/ Ergonomic Stand | LS32FG502

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 (FG502E / G50F) 32″ 2K QHD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (LS32FG502) sets a new benchmark for competitive mid-range 1440p gaming. Replacing older VA-based designs with a premium flat Fast IPS panel, this display eliminates black smearing and dark-level motion blur to deliver clean frame transitions. Featuring Quad HD resolution (2560 x 1440) across an expansive 32-inch screen canvas, a swift 180Hz refresh rate, and a true 1ms (GTG) pixel response time, the G5 FG502E ensures high-speed visual performance without compromising color precision or visual detail.

 Equipped with 99% sRGB color gamut coverage, true 8-bit color depth (16.7M colors), and HDR10 dynamic decoding, this display reproduces vivid, lifelike environments with high contrast stability. Dual adaptive synchronization via NVIDIA G-Sync Compatibility and AMD FreeSync maintains tear-free, stutter-free gameplay during peak graphical output. Complete with a fully ergonomic height-adjustable stand supporting tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, the LS32FG502 provides a versatile, feature-rich 2K display tailored for competitive multiplayer titles and immersive content creation.

 
 
 

 

 
 Expansive 32-Inch 2K QHD Flat Fast IPS Display

 Superior Motion Clarity and Rich Visual Detail

 Experience immersive visual performance on a spacious 32-inch flat screen canvas. Featuring 2K Quad HD (2560 x 1440) resolution, the Odyssey G5 provides 1.7 times the pixel density of standard Full HD monitors, offering extended visual real estate for complex game environments and multitasking work windows.

 Upgraded with Fast IPS panel technology, this display delivers wide 178-degree viewing angles while effectively eliminating dark-level ghosting and black smearing typical of traditional entry-level displays.

 

 
 180Hz Refresh Rate & True 1ms (GTG) Pixel Response

 Butter-Smooth Frame Transitions for Fast-Paced Action

 Dominating fast-moving game scenes is effortless with a rapid 180Hz refresh rate over DisplayPort connections. Displaying up to 180 frames per second, camera snaps, target tracking, and rapid motion vectors remain crisp and fluid.

 Paired with a true 1ms (Grey-to-Grey) response time, pixel color state changes happen virtually instantaneously. Motion blur, trailing artifacts, and screen haze are minimized to give you an immediate tactical edge in FPS, MOBA, and racing games.

 

 
 True 8-Bit Color Depth with 99% sRGB & HDR10

 Accurate Color Fidelity and Dynamic Scene Contrast

 Enjoy vibrant, true-to-life colors with 99% sRGB color spectrum coverage and a true 8-bit color depth rendering 16.7 million distinct shades. Texture details, character shaders, and game environments appear rich and accurate.

 HDR10 high dynamic range support boosts scene contrast by brightening highlight zones and deepening shadowed background areas, exposing fine details hidden in dark corners.

 

 
 NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible & AMD FreeSync

 Seamless Tear-Free and Stutter-Free Frame Delivery

 Keep screen tearing, frame stuttering, and input delay out of your gameplay. The Odyssey G5 dynamically synchronizes its 180Hz refresh rate with output frame rates from both NVIDIA GeForce and AMD Radeon graphics cards.

 This adaptive synchronization delivers smooth and uninterrupted frame flow during intense gameplay, even when frame rates fluctuate during heavy graphic renders.

 

 
 Fully Ergonomic Stand & Advanced Game Utilities

 Customizable Viewing Comfort and Tactical Screen Tools

 Configure your desktop setup with precision using the included Height Adjustable Stand (HAS). Adjust height, tilt, swivel, and pivot the screen up to 90 degrees into vertical orientation for specialized workflows or streaming setups.

ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A: Exceptional Gaming Performance in a Stunning Display 

 The ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A is a high-performance gaming monitor designed to provide smooth and immersive visuals for serious gamers. With a 27-inch 2K display, a fast 180Hz refresh rate, and a 1ms response time, this monitor is optimized for fast-paced gaming and competitive esports. Featuring G-Sync compatibility and an IPS panel, it ensures vibrant colors and sharp details while minimizing screen tearing and stuttering. Whether you're into fast shooters or action-packed RPGs, the TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A delivers an ultra-responsive and visually stunning gaming experience.

 
 

 Key Features

 27" 2K (2560x1440) Resolution 

 
• The 2K resolution offers a perfect balance between Full HD and 4K, providing sharp visuals without taxing your system.

• Ideal for gamers who want a crisp, detailed picture for a more immersive gaming experience.

 
 180Hz Refresh Rate 

 
• With an ultra-fast 180Hz refresh rate, the VG27AQ3A ensures incredibly smooth and fluid gameplay, reducing motion blur and making it perfect for high-speed gaming.

 1ms Response Time

• The monitor comes with an ergonomic stand that allows for tilt, swivel, height adjustment, and pivot, so you can customize it to your preferred viewing angle.

• Connect your preferred devices with ease, whether you're gaming on your PC or console.

• Protect your eyes from strain and fatigue without compromising image quality.

Samsung Odyssey G6 G60F 27″ QHD 350Hz IPS Gaming Monitor

 The Samsung Odyssey G6 27 G60F is a high-performance gaming monitor designed for players who want extremely fast refresh rates without dropping back to Full HD resolution. The exact Middle East model LS27FG600EMXUE combines a 27-inch flat IPS panel , 2560 × 1440 QHD resolution , a maximum 350Hz refresh rate , and an ultra-fast 1ms GTG response time .

 This combination makes the Odyssey G6 particularly attractive for competitive PC gaming. QHD delivers significantly more image detail than 1080p, while the 350Hz refresh rate is designed for gamers using powerful systems capable of producing very high frame rates.

 27-Inch QHD Gaming Display

 2560 × 1440 Resolution

 The Odyssey G6 uses a native QHD resolution of 2560 × 1440 pixels with a standard 16:9 aspect ratio .

 At 27 inches, QHD provides a strong balance between screen size, image sharpness and GPU performance requirements. It delivers substantially more workspace and detail than Full HD while remaining less demanding than 4K when targeting very high frame rates.

 Samsung specifies an active display area of 596.736 × 335.664mm , making this a conventional 27-inch desktop display suitable for competitive gaming as well as general productivity and multimedia.

 Fast IPS Panel

 Wide Viewing Angles and 99% sRGB

 The Samsung LS27FG600 uses an IPS panel with wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles .

 Samsung lists typical brightness at 350 cd/m² , minimum brightness at 280 cd/m² and a typical static contrast ratio of 1000:1 . The monitor supports up to 16.7 million colours and provides 99% sRGB coverage .

 That combination makes the G6 suitable for users who want competitive gaming performance while retaining strong colour reproduction and consistent viewing characteristics.

 350Hz Refresh Rate

 Extreme Speed for Competitive Gaming

 The biggest performance feature of the Odyssey G6 G60F is its maximum 350Hz refresh rate .

 A 350Hz panel can refresh the displayed image up to 350 times per second when connected to compatible hardware and when the game is producing sufficient frame rates. That can provide smoother motion and lower perceived latency than conventional 60Hz, 144Hz, 165Hz, 180Hz or 240Hz monitors.

 Samsung specifically positions the 350Hz refresh rate as a competitive-gaming feature intended to minimize delay and improve responsiveness during fast gameplay.

 1ms GTG Response Time

 Fast Pixel Response

 Samsung officially rates the G60F at 1ms GTG response time .

 GTG, or Gray-to-Gray, measures how quickly individual pixels transition between different shades. Faster pixel transitions can help reduce visible ghosting and motion blur during rapid camera movements.

 Samsung notes that the 1ms result is measured under internal test conditions using the monitor’s Extreme mode , and actual performance can vary according to settings and content.

 NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible

 Smooth NVIDIA Gaming

 The Odyssey G6 is officially listed as NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible .

 With a compatible NVIDIA graphics card, the monitor can synchronize its refresh behaviour with the GPU to reduce visible screen tearing, stuttering and choppy motion as frame rates fluctuate.

 This makes it a particularly strong match for gaming PCs equipped with modern NVIDIA GeForce graphics cards.

 AMD FreeSync Premium

 Variable Refresh Rate for AMD GPUs

 Samsung also includes AMD FreeSync Premium , giving the monitor variable refresh rate support for compatible AMD Radeon graphics hardware.

 This means the G6 supports adaptive synchronization across both major gaming GPU platforms, providing greater flexibility when choosing or upgrading a graphics card.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400

 HDR Gaming Support

 The Samsung Odyssey G6 G60F carries VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification.

 DisplayHDR 400 provides an established HDR performance standard rather than simply indicating basic HDR signal compatibility. Combined with the monitor’s IP

whiteangel-qsnjno.description:
Samsung Odyssey G7 G70D 32″ 4K 144Hz Gaming Monitor LS32DG702

 The Samsung Odyssey G7 LS32DG702 is a premium 32-inch gaming monitor designed for gamers who want the combination of 4K UHD resolution, a fast IPS panel, 144Hz refresh rate and 1ms GTG response time in one large-screen display.

 Samsung officially lists the LS32DG702 as a 32-inch flat Odyssey G7 G70D with a native resolution of 3840 × 2160 , delivering four times the pixel count of Full HD. With its combination of high resolution and fast refresh rate, the monitor is suitable for gaming PCs, modern consoles, competitive gaming and high-quality multimedia use.

 32-Inch 4K UHD Gaming Display

 Sharp 3840 × 2160 Resolution

 The Odyssey G7 G70D uses a 32-inch 16:9 display with a native 4K UHD resolution of 3840 × 2160 pixels .

 The larger 32-inch screen gives games, movies and productivity applications more visual space, while the 4K resolution delivers significantly finer detail than standard 1080p displays.

 Samsung specifies an active display area of 698.112 × 392.688mm , making the G7 suitable for users who prefer a large desktop gaming experience without moving into ultrawide formats.

 Fast IPS Panel

 Wide Viewing Angles and Rich Colour

 Samsung equips the LS32DG702 with a Fast IPS panel .

 The display offers 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles , allowing colours and image quality to remain consistent even when the screen is viewed from the side.

 Samsung rates typical brightness at 350 cd/m² , static contrast at 1000:1 , support for up to 1 billion colours , and 99% sRGB coverage . These specifications make the monitor useful not only for gaming but also for general multimedia and everyday visual work.

 144Hz Refresh Rate and 1ms GTG

 Smooth and Responsive Gaming

 One of the main advantages of the Samsung Odyssey G7 32 is its combination of high resolution and gaming speed.

 Samsung officially specifies a maximum refresh rate of 144Hz , allowing compatible PCs and consoles to display up to 144 refreshes per second.

 Response time is rated at 1ms GTG , helping reduce visible motion blur during fast-paced gameplay. Samsung notes that the measured 1ms GTG result depends on monitor settings and test conditions.

 This makes the monitor suitable for fast-moving titles including racing, shooters, action games and competitive multiplayer games while still retaining the visual detail of a 4K panel.

 AMD FreeSync Premium and G-Sync Compatibility

 Smoother Variable Refresh Rate Gaming

 The Samsung LS32DG702 officially supports AMD FreeSync Premium and is also listed by Samsung as G-Sync Compatible .

 Variable refresh rate technology helps synchronise the display refresh rate with compatible graphics hardware, reducing visual tearing and stuttering when frame rates change during gaming.

 For users building a powerful gaming PC with an NVIDIA GeForce or AMD Radeon graphics card, this gives the G7 broader compatibility for smoother gameplay.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400

 HDR Gaming and Improved Dynamic Range

 Samsung certifies the monitor for VESA DisplayHDR 400 and also lists support for HDR10+ Gaming .

 HDR support improves the monitor’s ability to display differences between bright and dark areas in compatible HDR content, while Samsung’s HDR gaming features are designed to enhance supported gaming experiences.

 The combination of 4K resolution, IPS colour performance and HDR support gives the G7 a stronger visual feature set than basic high-refresh gaming monitors.

 HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4

 Modern PC and Console Connectivity

 The Odyssey G7 LS32DG702 offers excellent connectivity for gaming setups.

 Samsung officially provides:

 
• 2 × HDMI 2.1 

• 1 × DisplayPort 1.4 

• 2 × USB 3.0 hub ports 

• 1 × USB-B upstream 

• Ethernet LAN 

• Wi-Fi 5 

• Bluetooth 5.2 

 
 HDMI 2.1 makes the monitor particularly useful for current gaming hardware that benefits from high-resolution, high-refresh-rate connectivity.

 This 32-inch monitor includes a fully ergonomic stand with adjustable height, swivel, and tilt options, allowing you to position it for maximum comfort during long gaming or work sessions. The Game Bar feature allows you to make on-the-fly adjustments to settings like FPS, HDR, and more, ensuring a tailored experience every time.
